KINDS missing=[ac,save,weapon,conditional,choice,classDc,spellcasting] — the largest single red. Six of the seven are closed by a TEACH, not a settle: advancement.ts is keyed <classId> AND <subclassId>, a subclass key is a COMPLETE table that replaces the class default, and its rows name the printed CLAUSE in `source` ('initial-creed', 'lesser-creed', 'major-creed', 'true-creed') rather than the subclass — so the existing `source` scan credited the doctrine with nothing. wg-diff now also credits the whole table a subclass OPTION owns, the exact bound wg-values.mjs:141-150 already puts on the same teach. Blast radius MEASURED: exactly three advancement.ts tables are subclass-keyed (warpriest, battle-creed, light-mortar-innovation) and a class-keyed table is credited to nobody, which is why a file-wide REGISTRY_KINDS entry for advancement.ts was rejected — it would credit ~30 class and subclass keys with a whole chassis each.

The seventh kind, `choice`. SETTLE, wg-diff VERIFIED_EQUIVALENT 'battle-creed': ['choice']. Their two `select from:ADJ_VALUE "Select Deity Weapon"` ops are a workaround for not resolving the deity's favored weapon; doctrine-6 offers no pick ('your deity's favored weapon'), and build.ts:3784 writes master@13 / expert@5 as a per-weapon override over EVERY entry of the chosen deity's favoredWeapons, so even a multi-weapon deity owes the player nothing to select. Cites the existing parking entry in work/experience-instrument-limits.json (lane derived-value-not-a-pick, verified 2026-09-08), whose refuter is the multi-weapon-deity case.
